items.title: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt
items.summary: Developers will now backport fixes and cut releases immediately for flaws flagged as “easily discoverable,” abandoning long embargoes for bugs an attacker can surface with a single AI prompt.

items.title: Lighter Adds weETH as Perpetual Futures Collateral
items.summary: Lighter counts 70% of weETH’s index value toward trading margin and caps platform-wide collateral supply at 1,000 weETH.

items.title: Initia halts network after security incident as attacker reportedly mints tokens
items.summary: Onchain data shows a $2.7 million ether transfer as Initia investigates the scope of a security incident.

items.title: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations
items.summary: The SEC’s latest priorities highlight tokenization as an emerging market risk, while cryptocurrencies remain absent as a standalone examination category.
